name: NEET Physics Practice Prep - Practice Test 2

questions.question: What is the dimensional formula for gravitational constant (G)?
A body is projected vertically upwards with a velocity of 20 m/s. Maximum height reached is (g = 10 m/s^2):
What is the SI unit of magnetic flux?
questions.hint: Weber is the SI unit of magnetic flux.

questions.question: Which electromagnetic wave has the shortest wavelength?
questions.hint: Gamma-rays have the highest frequency and shortest wavelength in the EM spectrum.

questions.question: A convex lens has a focal length of 20 cm. Its power is:
What is the value of escape velocity from the surface of Earth?
questions.hint: Escape velocity from Earth is approximately 11.2 km/s.

questions.question: The acceleration due to gravity (g) is maximum at which location?
questions.hint: g is maximum at the poles because Earth is an oblate spheroid and polar radius is minimum.

questions.question: Sound waves traveling through air are classified as which type of wave?
questions.hint: Sound in air travels as pressure waves (rarefactions and compressions), which are longitudinal mechanical waves.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electrical conductivity?
questions.hint: Siemens per meter (S/m) is the standard unit of electrical conductivity.

questions.question: The working of optical fiber is based on which optical phenomenon?
questions.hint: Optical fibers guide light signals using continuous Total Internal Reflection (TIR) inside the core cladding.

questions.question: What is the angle of contact for pure water and clean glass?
questions.hint: Pure water completely wets clean glass, resulting in a contact angle of 0 degrees.

questions.question: Which instrument is specifically used to measure solar radiation?
questions.hint: A pyrheliometer is designed to measure direct beam solar irradiance.

questions.question: Absolute zero temperature corresponds to what value in Celsius?
questions.hint: Absolute zero is 0 K, which equals -273.15 °C.

questions.question: What is the weight of a body at the center of the Earth?
questions.hint: At the center of the Earth, acceleration due to gravity (g) is zero, so the weight (m * g) is also zero.

questions.question: Light waves exhibit transverse nature because they can be:
questions.hint: Only transverse waves can be polarized; longitudinal waves cannot.
